ja47_interpretation: All 27 required top-level properties reject individual omission. effect_id is required only for effect subject; forbidden for attention_action/broker_lease.

Nested subject discriminant/identity, present proof and broker_identity required fields reject individual omission on branch-valid fixtures. Resolving decision fixture must have its matching proof; preserve_unknown legitimately has empty proof arrays.
Required nullable binding_generation/support_profile_digest must reject omission but legitimate null remains accepted in the allowed legacy/broker branch.

Each proof-envelope context owner_generation/binding_generation/support_profile_digest/prior_phase/schema_spec_digest/recovery_build_digest must be present and exactly match receipt; missing or mismatched rejects.

Deletion test starts with positive valid decode/verifier case, changes one property only, observes actual parser/verifier rejection and unchanged persisted state if host exists. File existence is never evidence validity.
ja20_required_inputs: Exact separate broker database namespace and source/target schema numbers; distinguish candidate spec from globally reserved/runtime migration.
Executable frozen DDL bytes, valid owner+generation+resource+lease fixtures with a held orphan, precise broker/lease/home/effect identity, corresponding immutable operator-decision schema if claimed.
Full source/target sqlite_master catalogs, target table list, SHA-256 manifest and precise algorithm/domain; actual SQLite instantiation with integrity/foreign-key checks.
Home source/target DDL and genuine old attention_dispatch_holds fixture retained; broker fixture supplements rather than substitutes for home evidence.
Dependency graph names home schema_spec->home recovery and broker schema_spec->broker recovery; no controller-start reverse cycle; no component/full legacy equivalence.
broker_sql_negative_oracles: Negative, fractional, null/missing and >MAX_SAFE_INTEGER generations rejected where field is integer identity. Generation zero allowed only if schema/spec explicitly permits it.
Unknown owner/home/resource FK tuple or mismatched broker/lease identity fails; coherent alternate identity is not automatically an attack and must be scoped by host.
Two held leases for one exclusive canonical resource cannot coexist; orphan held row is not released by age/owner absence alone.

Identical principal/request identity cannot append two immutable decision rows; conflicting request digest must not overwrite/replace/delete a prior decision. SQL uniqueness is not authorized replay implementation.
Unknown/held orphan resolving decision without matching immutable proof metadata rejected where DDL claims enforcement; authenticity/current authority remain host obligations.
INSERT OR REPLACE/IGNORE/upsert do not rewrite immutable decision history; stale subject revision and duplicate decision history rejected if specified.
Only standalone scratch SQLite, no runtime registration, no default/reserved OSSTACK_HOME, no production migration.
n0_preservation_oracles: JA01 exact source semantic fields retained: independent task/session read, missing checks/review rejects local_verified while observed_turn remains. Existing prototype is not rerun as new acceptance.
JA02 exact source semantic fields retained: wrong repository/scope admission rejects with zero adapter calls. Parser-only gate cannot satisfy integration.
Component/contract gate may unblock only named contract consumers; J01.scoped retains JA01/JA02/JA59 and full integration meaning.
Legacy wrapper/case/producer closure and every_artifact_release survive unchanged; J27/local/default release must not substitute contract/component gate for J01.scoped.
Deleting JA01/JA02 mapping or mandatory legacy case, replacing release with contract-only, introducing dependency cycle, or applying home-only override with broker enabled must fail validation.
All added gates remain specified_not_run, runtime false. No inferred live qualification or full J01/J11 done.
